boundary: BT1377 is a cross-artifact architecture contract. It does not set an optical clock speed, prove a hardware threshold, or prove that the deterministic Clifford scheduler alone is universal.
how_it_physically_computes: A logical packet digit is compiled into an 8-tick optical word. The first three ticks program ternary tritter/EOM axes, the last five ticks switch delay-line apartment hops, and BT1374 lowers the packet address to a single-bit Q6 edge.  BT1376 supplies the S3 phase synchronization frontier, while BT1375 makes generation advance the actual central C3 action on Steinberg cycle vectors. Repeating the 72-tick oscillator frame for 720 frames gives the 51840-window finite Clifford runtime.

physical_pipeline.physical_action: choose three ternary axes and up to five apartment hops
ticks 0..2 are tritter/EOM phase pulses; ticks 3..7 are delay-line switch pulses
lower the packet to a single-bit Q6 edge / switch rail
apply 330 nonidentity phase/counterconnection corrections; no radius-3 local improvement exists
advance by the central C3 operator on concrete cycle-vector witnesses

physical_pipeline.logical_object: Hesse-SIC/T measurement or Fibonacci braid resource
physical_pipeline.physical_action: inject the non-Clifford resource at a measurement/topological boundary

title: Physical universal-computation contract for the holonet
